mode: descriptive diagnostic; no fitting or model selection
question: How do existing B_env static features differ between captured and missed positives?

definition.positive: at least one report in test period
definition.captured: positive among first ceil(0.05*n) cells in metrics.rank_order(saved B_env score,seed=0)
definition.quantiles: finite values only; NaN/inf counted as missing, never imputed
definition.consistent_rank: same nonzero Cliff sign in B2 and B3, ordered by min(abs(delta_B2),abs(delta_B3))

feature_notes.landcover: WorldCover 2021 cell fractions; _500/_1500 are square-window means of cell fractions, not circular cover shares
feature_notes.forest_edge: negative inside >=50% tree cell, positive outside, metres to nearest boundary cell
feature_notes.pop_500/pop_2000: WorldPop 2020 estimated persons summed in 11x11 / 41x41 cells
feature_notes.bldg_500: OSM snapshot building centroids summed in 11x11 cells
feature_notes.osm_distances: Euclidean cell-centre distances to mapped OSM features, not walking distance
feature_notes.elev/slope/tpi_500: GSI DEM elevation m, slope degrees, elevation minus 11x11 valid-cell mean m

tree.unit: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels in 100m cell

crop.unit: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels in 100m cell

limitations: Selection is determined by model scores derived from these same features, so group differences do not establish causal drivers or feature importance. B2/B3 share cells; no independent replication. Correlated features, observation bias, and 2026 partial-year labels remain. No p-values or multiple-test claims.
